\section{Configuration, validation and reproduction}
\label{app:tables}

These tables give every circuit, estimator, parameter range, shot budget, fit range and interval method used, the checks each computation passed, the scope in which each result holds, and what it took to run. Every entry is copied from a report or result file in the repository; \texttt{paper/\allowbreak{}appendix/\allowbreak{}PROVENANCE.md} names the file and line or computation behind each cell. NOT RECORDED marks a value that was not logged; none is estimated. All computations are classical simulations; no quantum hardware was used.

Experiments are identified as in the repository. Stages~3--7 are the experiments on the RX-product benchmark that precede this paper's analyses. B1 is the slope rule on entangling circuits (section~\ref{sec:results-b1}), B2 the four-estimator comparison (section~\ref{sec:results-b2}), B3 the seed-to-seed and sign-accuracy checks (sections~\ref{sec:results-b3} and~\ref{sec:results-sign}) and B4 the depolarising-noise overlay (section~\ref{sec:results-b4}).
